instruction: Terrace housing conversion from init.ifc. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png as references while converting it into the required three-storey terrace housing. The init file has a different starting arrangement and must be reshaped into the specified final storey and zone organization. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. Keep the shaped model envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and max 22.0, 4.0, 10.5, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must have unique GlobalId values, exactly three building storeys, exactly eight IfcSpace zones, at least twelve walls, at least three slabs, and at least five roof elements. Put TERRACE-UNIT-1-A and TERRACE-UNIT-1-B on the lower storey; TERRACE-UNIT-2-A, TERRACE-UNIT-2-B, and TERRACE-1 on the middle storey; and TERRACE-UNIT-3-A, TERRACE-UNIT-3-B, and TERRACE-2 on the upper storey. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
